description.value:
Price 12,000 gp; Slot none; Weight 8 lb.; Capacity 10; Usage 5 charges per use

A folding maintenance cradle from the Divinity's android workshops, “complimentary with purchase.” An android or other construct that rests in it for 10 minutes regains 10d6 hit points and is cured of one of the following conditions: fatigued, sickened, staggered or confused. It also lets its user find and purge factory override phrases, like the one Celmak holds over Meyanda, without a check.

Construction Requirements Craft Technological Item, military lab; Cost 6,000 gp; Craft DC 26.

Found in: Mint Condition (Meyanda's episode).

effect: Androids/constructs only; also cures fatigued, sickened, staggered or confused
